about.label: About Us
about.title: A valuation firm built on trust
about.description: Damno Valuation provides property, bank collateral, business valuation, and loss assessment services in compliance with the Mongolian Law on Asset Valuation, YOVC, IVS, and STOУС standards through a team of 35 specialists. Licensed by the Ministry of Finance on November 28, 2023 (No. 140600033, unlimited term), Damno Valuation delivers practical, evidence-based valuations with a three-stage quality control process and professional liability insurance from Practical Insurance LLC.

service_0_description: Valuation of apartments, houses, land, and buildings in Ulaanbaatar and provincial regions.
service_1_description: Professional valuation of vehicles, mining equipment, industrial lines, and other movable assets.
service_2_description: Company valuation, shares, financial instruments, brands, licenses, patents, and intangible assets.
service_3_description: Collateral valuation accepted by Khan Bank, State Bank, Trade and Development Bank, and other lenders.
service_4_description: Asset loss assessment and expert reports for police, courts, customs, and tax authorities.
service_5_description: Valuation of land, factories, offices, warehouses, retail spaces, and mining facilities.
